MDA slot 1 printed \"1\" at (33.2, 81.8), slot 2 \"2\" at (405.6, 81.5)."},"front-leds":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"SR1 Table 72 pp206-207 (Stat green / green slow blink / amber; Pwr blue; CF 1-3 green, amber fast blink, amber; BT green blink / green / amber; OT, Crit, Maj red; Min amber) and Table 73 pp208-209 (Mgmt, 1588/SyncE and OES1 link: green 100 Mb/s full-duplex, green blinking half-duplex, amber 10 Mb/s, amber blinking; activity green blinking, amber blinking on errors; OES2 for future use; BITS amber = configured and no clock, green = clock). Which of a jack's two windows is link and which is activity is not stated; led-a is taken as link. CF1 is the internal flash, \"currently not used\", but its lamp is fitted. The figure numbers the CF lamps 1-3 INSIDE the lamp circles; those numerals sit under the lamp parts and are not drawn. The lamps are drawn 2.9 mm across and are placed as common/led-dot@1 (2 mm), the part that fits the 3.5 mm CF pitch. The 1588/SyncE and BITS jacks are lamped parts although L76 files timing jacks as bare: Table 73 gives both lamps (SyncE link and activity, BITS a clock LED) and Figures 4 and 6 draw two windows on each, so the hardware wins over the rule's role heuristic."},"ground":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"SR1 p72: a two-stud safety ground left of the PSU area / terminal block, for the Panduit LCD6-10AH-L two-hole 45-degree lug in the accessory kit. Cards are HORIZONTAL and no bay rotates (SR1 Figure 55 p166; XP Figure 30). The MDA-e-XP family seats in any SR-1; the MDA2-e-XP family only in the 1.5 Tb/s revisions (3HE12298xxRD and higher, 3HE12299xxRB and higher, SR1 p46), which accepts cannot express. Figure 4 draws slot 1 with an ME6-100GB-QSFP28 and slot 2 with the impedance panel 3HE10312AA, of which one ships with each chassis (SR1 p84). The printed slot numbers \"1\" and \"2\" lie inside the bay boxes, in the notched lower corners every MDA plate leaves open (wings 27 mm tall, conventions section 2), which is where Figure 4 shows them readable with a card fitted; L21 reads the bay as a full rectangle."},"panel-scale":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Gate 1.
